fusions.name: Belt Hatchets
fusions.desc: Throws a hatchet from your belt that deals 8 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at its full reach of 6 tiles. Holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Chopping Block
fusions.desc: Holds the target down and brings the edge onto it for 26 damage, leaving it [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds and 20% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Full-Haft Grip
fusions.desc: For 15 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 30% further.

fusions.name: Along the Grain
fusions.desc: Your physical attacks ignore 15% of the target's armour.
